name: devcraft
description: DevCraft MCP server (22 tools). Local fleet cockpit for git, GitHub, Docker, reports, and craft apps.

tools.name: devcraft_audit_fleet
tools.description: Audit all workspace repositories, git dirty/untracked status, branch state, and AGENTS.md compliance across the fleet.

tools.name: devcraft_checkpoint_worktree
tools.description: Create an atomic snapshot of modified files into the time machine backup ledger before major edits.

tools.name: devcraft_audit_ports
tools.description: Audit reserved vs active local TCP ports (10700-15000) against WEBAPP_PORTS.md.

tools.name: devcraft_sandbox_run
tools.description: Execute a test or script inside an isolated Docker container or sandboxed subprocess.

tools.name: devcraft_restart_service
tools.description: Safely restart an NSSM Windows service adhering to the fleet sc.exe protocol.

tools.name: devcraft_discover_tools
tools.description: Search and discover MCP servers across the fleet by domain keyword.

tools.name: devcraft_status
tools.description: Cockpit version, root, and whether a scan is loaded.

tools.name: devcraft_refresh
tools.description: Scan sibling repositories and rebuild the board.

tools.name: devcraft_board
tools.description: Cards on the fleet board.

tools.name: devcraft_git
tools.description: Scanned repositories with branch and dirty counts.

tools.name: devcraft_digest
tools.description: Totals from the morning digest file.

tools.name: devcraft_reports
tools.description: Fleet reports with age and a stale mark.

tools.name: devcraft_crafts
tools.description: Craft app checkouts next to this repo.

tools.name: devcraft_brief
tools.description: Handover next step for one repository.

tools.name: devcraft_claim
tools.description: Hold a repository for one IDE (cursor, opencode, agy, or claude).

tools.name: devcraft_release
tools.description: Release a claim.

tools.name: devcraft_pin
tools.description: Pin or unpin a repository on the board.

tools.name: devcraft_move
tools.description: Move a board card. Computed columns are refused.

tools.name: devcraft_docker
tools.description: Docker daemon and running containers.

tools.name: devcraft_ports
tools.description: Registered ports against listeners.

tools.name: devcraft_open
tools.description: Open a checkout in Cursor, OpenCode, Claude, or Antigravity.

tools.name: devcraft_reveal
tools.description: Open a fleet report in the shell.
